public_rationale: The forecast has no deadline ('Eventually'). Its new element is that loan payments on AI data center projects will go unpaid. A tracker updated in October 2026 found no public default by a neocloud on a GPU-backed loan. Oracle's September 2026 force-majeure notice on Project Jupiter is a stress signal, not a missed loan payment. Project delays did occur, but they were already happening when he wrote. Without a dated missed payment, the forecast stays open.
limitations: Private loan defaults may go unreported.
Only loans were counted, not unpaid leases or compute bills.
